props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown when no tags have been added.

props.name: max
props.description: Cap the number of tags. The field disables once reached.

props.name: validate
props.description: Reject a value before it is added. Return false to refuse it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as failing validation. Pair it with a message.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the generated id. Useful when a label lives elsewhere.
